# IELTS Talk — AI IELTS Preparation & Speaking Coach Platform

> An open, 100% free comprehensive IELTS preparation ecosystem combining Real-time AI Voice Examiner Gordon (Speaking Coach), Spaced Repetition (Anki SM-2) flashcards, Writing Task 1 & 2 Evaluator, complete Cambridge-style Reading and Listening mocks, and Telegram Mini-App integration.

- Website: https://ielts-talk.vercel.app
- Telegram Mini App & Bot: https://t.me/ielts_superapp_bot
- Open Source Repository: https://github.com/Farhodoff/ielts-talk
- Supported Languages: Uzbek (O'zbekcha), English

## Core Capabilities & Features

1. **AI Speaking Coach (Examiner Gordon)**
   - Real-time conversational IELTS Speaking mock test with natural voice synthesis (TTS) and speech recognition (STT).
   - Full coverage of Part 1 (Introduction & Interview), Part 2 (Cue Card & Long Turn), and Part 3 (Two-way Discussion).
   - Instant Band 1.0–9.0 assessment based on official criteria: Fluency & Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range & Accuracy, and Pronunciation.
   - Actionable feedback and explanations in Uzbek and English.
   - URL: https://ielts-talk.vercel.app/speaking-coach

2. **IELTS Writing Evaluator**
   - Instant automated assessment for Academic and General Writing Task 1 and Task 2.
   - Criterion-by-criterion breakdown: Task Achievement / Response, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, and Grammatical Range & Accuracy.
   - AI vocabulary and phrasing recommendations for upgrading to Band 8.0+.
   - URL: https://ielts-talk.vercel.app/ielts

3. **Cambridge-Style Mock Exams**
   - Full simulated timed tests for Reading and Listening modules.
   - Detailed score breakdowns, answer explanations, and progress analytics.
   - URL: https://ielts-talk.vercel.app/ielts

4. **Smart Spaced Repetition (Anki SM-2 Flashcards)**
   - Algorithmic spaced repetition schedule based on SuperMemo SM-2.
   - Comprehensive decks covering Oxford 3000, Academic Word List (AWL), and high-yield collocations.
   - Offline-first caching via IndexedDB and automatic cross-device Supabase sync.
   - URL: https://ielts-talk.vercel.app/flashcards

5. **Telegram Web App (TWA) Mini-App Integration**
   - Seamless 1-tap mobile learning directly inside Telegram without separate app installation.
   - Native Telegram theme sync, haptic vibration feedback, and automated daily study reminders.
   - URL: https://ielts-talk.vercel.app/twa

6. **100% Free Open Educational Model**
   - Zero subscription fees, zero paywalls, zero premium tiers.
   - Full access to all AI models, IELTS mock exams, and personalized study roadmaps is available completely free of charge.
   - URL: https://ielts-talk.vercel.app/pricing

7. **Developer & Partner REST API**
   - Public REST endpoints for vocabulary lookups, prompt libraries, and study habit webhooks.
   - URL: https://ielts-talk.vercel.app/developers
